FXUSDCAD.name: FXUSDCAD
FXUSDCAD.label: USD/CAD
FXUSDCAD.description: Daily average exchange rate of the US dollar in Canadian dollars.

provenance.limits: Newer data exist: the series runs to 2026-11-06, after the end of the range asked for (2026-10-30). Today is 2026-11-07; for the latest values pass recent, recent_months or recent_years instead of a date range.
provenance.licence: Bank of Canada Terms of Use (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/): attribute the Bank of Canada as the source and indicate if changes were made, without implying the Bank endorses the use; content passed on through paid services must be identified as obtained from the Bank's website.
caveats: Indicative rate: one Bank of Canada daily average per currency, published by about 16:30 ET each business day. It is not a transactional rate; banks and dealers trade at their own rates.
provenance.reproduce: For scripts, call reproduce_code with this tool's name and arguments.
